args.text:
Batch: 15 runs. 9 accepted (r02, r03, r06, r08, r10, r11, r12, r13, r14) and 6 declined (r01, r04, r05, r07, r09, r15).
Flagged (2):
- r10, reason width_free_ratio_used. Its largest width-free ratio is -1.142, against a batch median of -0.351 (z -8.75). Rigid invariance only just passes (1.934 against 2.0), and that was after the tracker disk radius went from 15 to 30 px and after 2 roll-backs.
- r14, reason summary_outlier. Its strain-rate profile has a different shape from the other roots. The growth zone is 295 µm against 526 µm (z -14.16). The peak is at 358 µm (z 2.83). The REGR peak is 67.66 %/h (z 26.49). Its width-free ratio is +0.619, the opposite sign from every other root (z 10.73).
Cleared (7): r02, r03, r06, r08, r11, r12, r13. All checks that were run passed. Peak position, growth-zone length and flank difference are close to the batch. r03's higher REGR peak (48.86 %/h) comes with a normal profile shape, so it is read as a faster root.
What the flagged runs share: both were reported with the width-free ratio, and in both that ratio is far from the batch. Both also kept 2 remedies after roll-backs and have a high centre REGR peak.
